name: I Was Summoned to Another World, but All I Do Is Organize a Run-Down Village
summary: The Hero saved the world. Then he smashed every jar in your village looking for loose change. You got the class Neighbour and the skill Organizer. Put 4,584 things back where they belong — you'll have to learn whose style they are — before he comes through the door again.
